title: Liaquat and Dow Medical and Health Sciences Universities Amendment Ordinance 2005

sections.shortTitle: Liaquat and Dow Medical and Health Sciences Universities Amendment Ordinance 2005
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 2005
ORDINANCE XVIII OF
2005
LIAQUAT AND DOW
MEDICAL AND HEALTH
SCIENCES UNIVERSITIES
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2005
An Ordinance to further
amend the Liaquat
University
of Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance, 2001 and
the Dow
University of Health Sciences Act, 2004
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinay, Part I,
27th December, 2005]
No.S.Legis:1(18)/2005,
dated 27-12-2005.---The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general
information:-
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Liaquat University of
Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance, 2001 and the Dow University of Health
Sciences Act, 2004, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor of Sindh is satisfied
that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the
Governor of Sindh is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Liaquat and Dow Medical and Health Sciences Universities
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2005.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Liaquat University of
Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance, 2001 and the Dow University of Health
Sciences Act, 2004, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor of Sindh is satisfied
that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the
Governor of Sindh is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:-
2. Amendment of Sindh
Ordinance VIII of 2001.---In the Liaquat University
of Medical and Health
Sciences Ordinance, 2001:--
(i) in section 13, for subsection (1), the following shall be
substituted:--
"(1) The Minister of Health shall be
the Pro-Chancellor of the University.";
(ii) in section
14, for subsection (1), the following shall be substituted:--
"(1) Any person having medical
background shall be appointed Vice Chancellor by the Chancellor for a period of
four years on such terms and conditions as the Chancellor may determine and
shall hold office during the pleasure of the Chancellor."
(iii) in section
16, for subsection (1), the following shall be substituted:--
"(1) The Registrar shall be a whole
time officer of the University and shall be appointed by the Syndicate on such
terms and conditions as it may determine," and
(iv) in section
19, in subsection (1), for the words "Provincial Audit Department",
the word "Syndicate" shall be substituted.

3. Amendment of Sindh
Act X of 2004.---In the Dow University
of Health Sciences Act, 2004-
(i)
section 11, shall be renumbered as subsection (1) of that section, and
thereafter the following new subsection shall be added:-
"(2) Should the Chancellor be
incapacitated acting as such due to absence or any other cause, the
Pro-Chancellor shall exercise all the powers and perform all the duties of the
Chancellor.";
(ii) in section
12, for subsection (1), the following shall be substituted:-
"(1) Any person having medical
background shall be appointed Vice-Chancellor by the Chancellor for a period of
four years on such terms and conditions as the Chancellor may determine and
shall hold office during the pleasure of the Chancellor."
(iii) in section
20, in subsection (2), for the words "Pro-Vice Chancellor", the words
"Pro-Chancellor" shall be substituted; and
(iv) in section
22, in subsection (1)-
(a) in clause
(xi), the word "and" at the end shall be replaced by a semi colon;
and
(b) in clause
(xii), the full stop at the end shall be replaced by a semi colon and the word
"and" and thereafter the following new clause shall be added:--
"(xiii) one
alim and one woman of eminence not serving in any
educational institution to be nominated by the Chancellor."
